scope.observation_unit: one linked cell; chromosome rows are not biological replicates

B1.stop_policy: accepted callback or actual FG cap/numeric stop

B2.stop_policy: accepted callback or actual FG cap/numeric stop

canonical_stop_rule.terminal_reason: record accepted callback, FG cap, or numerical stop as observed

M1.parameterization: a=(yA+yB)/sqrt(2), b=(yA-yB)/sqrt(2), optimize a,b/2,q, then invert to yA,yB

real_selection.scope: each method x budget, compare two sources only

synthetic_definition.p_policy: profiled p throughout; do not fix p for known-e
synthetic_definition.production_e: reuse the existing 026 P2/N2 C0 1Mb production-e layer/counts for M0 and M1
synthetic_definition.known_e: only M0; use the separately exported generation exposure; no extra experiment
synthetic_definition.truth_coordinates: evaluator-only and opened only after candidate/release hash gate

N2_null_readout.truth_policy: common mean truth distance matrix duplicated across both reference columns
N2_null_readout.contrast: algebraically zero for every candidate; not evidence against a false split
N2_null_readout.N_only_copy_difference_rms: diagnostic only; report same-x0 initial and each final, plus M1-M0 final change
N2_null_readout.shape_error: internal implementation calibration only; never the primary R2 result

evaluation_definition.metric_name: Spearman-derived R2 geometry readout; not statistical R-squared

real_common_mask.rebuild: independently reconstruct and exact-compare positions, pair_i, pair_j, common per chromosome

two_copy_policy.missing_copy: all four rho metrics n/a; never average one valid copy

plot_definition.linked_measurement_note: 20 chromosome rows are one-cell linked measurements
source_delta_tables: M1-M0 within each source and budget
B2-B1 (double-base) within each source and method

release_gate.required_terminal_evidence: all 14 fits terminal, no active jobs, actual nfev/FG accounting present
release_gate.coordinate_gate: hash every real and synthetic candidate before opening truth/reference; full shape/finite coverage required
read_order: all 14 candidate hashes and shape checks

implementation.synthetic_adapter: bind pr.allele_calibration_evaluator.chromosome_metrics; do not call historical pooled-swap evaluate_run
implementation.real_adapter: bind frozen multires_r2 mask/evaluate_endpoint_chromosome and pr.r2comparison exact mask comparator
implementation.old_cli_warning: pr.allele_calibration evaluate remains 4x5 and pooled/legacy entry; never invoke it for this 2x3 synthetic scope
